STATUTORY COMPENDIUM AND OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES ON COASTAL REGULATION ZONE (CRZ) NOTIFICATION 1991 AND ENVIRONMENT (PROTECTION) ACT 1986
SUBJECT: Comprehensive Regulatory Manual on CRZ-I, CRZ-II, CRZ-III, and CRZ-IV Classifications, High Tide Line (HTL) Mapping Standards, FSI Freeze Provisions as on 19-Feb-1991, Division of Jurisdictional Powers between MoEF and MCZMA, and Penalty Provisions under Section 15 of EPA 1986.

1. LEGISLATIVE FRAMEWORK OF CRZ NOTIFICATION 1991

1.1 On 19th February 1991, the Ministry of Environment and Forests (MoEF), Government of India, in exercise of powers under Section 3(1) and Section 3(2)(v) of the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986, issued the Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) Notification, declaring coastal stretches of seas, bays, estuaries, creeks, rivers, and backwaters as Coastal Regulation Zone.

1.2 The primary objective of the CRZ Notification is to preserve fragile coastal ecosystems, prevent unauthorized industrial and residential developments along the High Tide Line (HTL), and protect traditional fisherfolk communities.

3. CORE CRZ-II REGULATION: FSI FREEZE AS ON 19-FEB-1991

3.1 Landward Side Alignment: Construction in CRZ-II is permissible only on the landward side of an existing authorized road or structure existing prior to 19th February 1991.

3.2 DCR Freeze Rule: Building proposals in CRZ-II are subject strictly to the Development Control Regulations (DCR) existing as on 19th February 1991. Any subsequent amendment to local building bylaws (such as introduction of TDR, DP road width FSI loading, or height relaxations passed after 19-Feb-1991) cannot be applied to CRZ-II plots without express MoEF notification.

4. DIVISION OF JURISDICTIONAL POWERS BETWEEN MCZMA AND MOEF

4.1 Project Cost Thresholds: Proposals involving investment above ₹ 5 Crores (or residential buildings in sensitive coastal zones) must be scrutinized by MCZMA and recommended to MoEF, New Delhi for final Environmental Clearance (EC).

5. PENAL PROVISIONS UNDER ENVIRONMENT (PROTECTION) ACT, 1986

5.1 Section 15 EPA Penalties: Any violation of CRZ Notification 1991 attracts imprisonment up to 5 years, or fine up to ₹ 1 Lakh, or both. Section 5 empowers the Central Government to issue directions for closure, prohibition, or demolition of unauthorized coastal structures.

Issued by Order of the State Government:


(V. P. RAJA / DR. S. C. GAIKWAD)
Principal Secretary (Environment) & Member Secretary, MCZMA
Environment Department, Mantralaya, Mumbai
